title: LLeMpower: Understanding Disparities in the Control and Access of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the estimated GPU compute costs for training and serving various LLMs against venture capital funding by country, national research budgets, and average individual incomes to quantify global disparities in LLM affordability, access, and control.

Evaluating and mapping the MMLU (Massive Multitask Language Understanding) benchmark performance of GPT-4 across different official national languages to demonstrate the performance disparity between English and other languages globally.
